info.title: Terrella catalog
info.description: Kit pieces, style specs, diorama recipes, generation jobs and a per-user cost ledger. Engine-agnostic: shipped geometry is glTF binary (.glb).

put.summary: Upload raw bytes; returns their SHA-256

get.summary: Download bytes by hash (public; hashes are unguessable)

post.summary: Create the next version of (kind, slug), or reuse an identical latest one

parameters.name: latest

schema.description: Only the highest version per (kind, slug)
schema.title: Latest

parameters.description: Only the highest version per (kind, slug)

schema.title: Response Lineage Assets  Asset Id  Lineage Get

post.summary: Register a recipe (idempotent by content hash)

get.summary: List, or find nearest with lat/lon (public)

post.summary: Worker: take the oldest queued job of the given kinds
Worker: record spend, charged to the job's owner
Worker: spend not tied to a job (charged to caller)

direct_usd.title: Direct Usd
direct_usd.description: Entries tagged with this asset, plus its producing job's untagged spend split across the job's results

lineage_usd.title: Lineage Usd
lineage_usd.description: direct + every ancestor's direct cost (each ancestor counted once)

dedupe.title: Dedupe
dedupe.description: If the latest version of (kind, slug) has the same blob and spec, return it (200, reused=true) instead of minting a new version. The existing asset's provenance and parents are kept.

reused.title: Reused
reused.description: True when POST /assets returned an existing identical asset

reserved_usd.title: Reserved Usd
reserved_usd.description: Estimates of this user's queued and running jobs

kit_amortised_usd.title: Kit Amortised Usd
kit_amortised_usd.description: Each kit asset's lineage cost divided by the number of recipes using it

result_asset_ids.title: Result Asset Ids
result_asset_ids.description: Assets this job produced or reused. Create new assets with job_id set; reused ones keep their original job and do not take a share of this job's spend.

estimate_usd.title: Estimate Usd
estimate_usd.description: Checked against the user's budget before enqueue

dedupe_key.title: Dedupe Key
dedupe_key.description: Defaults to a hash of kind + input

force.title: Force
force.description: Enqueue even if an identical job is open

extract_id.title: Extract Id
extract_id.description: Stable id of the OSM extract, e.g. a hash of the Overpass query result

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: External inputs: URLs, OSM ids, Wikipedia pages

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: e.g. CC0-1.0, ODbL-1.0 for OSM-derived data

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description:
Where an asset came from. Required on every asset.

`producer` is the tool or model family ("hi3d", "nano-banana", "blender:dutch_houses.py",
"human"). Unknown keys are kept, so pipelines can add what they need.

build_id.title: Build Id
build_id.description: An approved diorama_build, or null to unpublish

style_spec_id.title: Style Spec Id
style_spec_id.description: Asset id of a style_spec version (ids pin versions)

builds.title: Builds
builds.description: Existing diorama_build assets for this recipe, newest first

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: True when an approved build already exists

kit_family.title: Kit Family
kit_family.description: Which kit pieces this style draws from, e.g. 'nl-canal'

StyleSpecBody.title: StyleSpecBody
StyleSpecBody.description: What the generator consumes. A hallucination here can only produce a wrong colour.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Override: provider-reported cost. Otherwise priced from the price table.

token.title: Token
token.description: Shown once. Store it; only its hash is kept.
